bio: A bitter, cunning sage who prizes utility and secrecy. He favors subterfuge, moral traps, and forbidden fragments.
status: Hidden; appears indirectly via notes, proxies, or sealed tests.
mentorshipStyle: Cold pragmatist — puzzles, moral ledger tests, utility-first tasks. He rewards cunning and results, not righteousness.
uniquePerk: Shadow Ledger — successful tasks grant a deterministic small-steal effect against rivals (seedable); high affinity unlocks a mentor-exclusive hidden manual.
notes: Spawn as global/secret events; outcomes impact long-term karma and faction reputation. Use deterministic seeding for repeatability.

bio: The patient architect of providence; he cultivates through concealment, time, and subtle bargains. Prefers slow, hidden growth.
location: Archive of Quiet Epochs (buried mountain library)
status: Reclusive; rarely meets apprentices in person; sows delayed tests across the years.
mentorshipStyle: Long-term planning — time-locked tasks, delayed rewards and karmic concealment.
uniquePerk: Providence Veil — while mentored, player gains a diminishing chance to avoid Karma-targeting events; very high affinity unlocks 'Hidden Longevity'.
notes: Design stages that deliver rewards after a world-time offset. Good fit for delayed-unlock mechanics and time-locked RNG seeding.

bio: Flame Emperor and charismatic leader — direct, explosive teacher. Prefers hands-on combat, flame refinement, and pill-work.
status: Public and active; hosts open training seasons and pill-forges.
mentorshipStyle: High-risk, high-reward combat and refinement sessions; visible and reputation-generating.
uniquePerk: Flame Affinity — speeds learning for fire manuals, grants temporary flame-resonance buffs during tribulation.
notes: Public mentorships attract rival attention; design visible triggers and faction responses around his stages.

bio: The patient pillsmith and treasure conservator. His approach is accumulation: pillcraft, artifact appraisal, and steady survival.
status: Quietly active; sends students on long treasure hunts and appraisals.
mentorshipStyle: Resource- and crafting-focused: appraisal challenges, long-brew timers, vault escorts.
uniquePerk: Treasure Affinity — improved yields from appraisals/refinings and compound pill bonuses.
notes: Tie appraisals to merchant_appraisal executor; use long durations for brewing stages to reward patient players.

bio: Eccentric and cunning; manipulates minor laws and bargains with oddities. Rewards creative solutions and lateral thinking.
location: Paradox Halls (wandering rifts and paradoxical venues)
mentorshipStyle: Unorthodox law-bending and paradox tests; favors improvisation.
uniquePerk: Law-Flex — can temporarily alter a local rule during an event (deterministic when seeded); unlocks minor permanent lawcraft when affinity is high.
notes: Executors for Meng Hao must accept nonstandard args; always use seeded RNG for reproducible outcomes.

bio: A fierce sword tutor blending grace and tenacity. She trains body, mind, and a refined sword-heart; her lessons emphasize precision and righteous fury.
location: Azure Sword Pavilion (a riverside terrace of blade-etched stone)
status: Active and visible; organizes seasonal sword conclaves.
mentorshipStyle: Disciplined swordcraft: strict drills, formation practice, and technical duels emphasizing intent and form.
uniquePerk: Blade Resonance — sword skills trained under Fu Yao gain a persistent 'intent echo' buff (secondary damage proc). High affinity can unlock a limited single-target 'realm-edge' echo.
notes: Replace previous Ji Ning stage hooks with Fu Yao equivalents; implement the 'intent echo' in the duel executor as an attachable buff with cooldown and deterministic proc logic.

bio: A master smith and battle tactician who forges weapons as cultivation. He combines battlefield resource hunts with deep tempering rituals.
location: The Southern Crucible (a mountain forge built on a war-ley)
status: Semi-retired; leads seasonal forging festivals and war-camps.
mentorshipStyle: Craft+Combat hybrid: resource foraging, cave forays, forging puzzles, and heavy tempering duels.
uniquePerk: Forge Resonance — improved weapon upgrade yield and a chance to soul-bond weapons crafted under Su Ming's tutelage.
notes: Use cave_explore for resource hunts; link forging mini-games and 'soul-bond' roll into the forge executor (seedable RNG).

bio: A stoic paragon of discipline and virtue. He teaches restraint, moral clarity, and the harmony between rule and will — training is strict but steady.
location: Cloud-Reed Terrace (a cliffside hall of ancient rules and qin stones)
status: Present and vigilant; accepts apprentices by invitation and via strict testing.
mentorshipStyle: Rigid discipline with emphasis on moral integrity, musical meditation (qin), and silent endurance tests. Favors righteous acts and measured responses.
uniquePerk: Honor Ward — while mentored, player gains slower reputation decay and higher favor with righteous/family sects; high affinity unlocks the 'Qin Harmony' passive that boosts mental resistances.
notes: Lan Wangji mentorships are ideal for players pursuing righteous/faction-friendly playstyles. Use moral-choice checks and qin-meditation executors that increase discipline and reduce insanity/temptation variables.
